Given the high seroprevalence of HuNoV in the Ugandan population, we used the clinical data available within EMaBS to determine the impact of FUT2 and ABO variation on episodes of diarrhea during early childhood. We identified a significantly lower rate of doctor-diagnosed diarrhea in Se- participants <1 year old (hazard ratio 0.89; 95% CI, 0.79-1.00); however, the difference was not sustained to age 5 years.
